_metadata.description: Known file system minifilter drivers classified by CSV compatibility. Used by HyperVInventory-CSVHealth module. Update this file to extend coverage without modifying module code.
_metadata.author: Michael George

CVDLP.remediation: Not CSV-compatible. Remove from Hyper-V hosts via CommCell Console or exclude C:\ClusterStorage paths. VM-level VSA backups do not require CVDLP on the host.

CVOFSF.remediation: May not be CSV-compatible in older versions. Check CommVault support matrix for current agent version.

mfewfpk.remediation: Known to cause CSV issues. Use McAfee cluster-aware ENS configuration or exclude C:\ClusterStorage paths.

MfeAVFK.remediation: Exclude CSV paths. Verify AV exclusions include VHD/VHDX/AVHDX extensions.

symefa.remediation: Must use SEP cluster-aware configuration. Verify Auto-Protect exclusions cover C:\ClusterStorage.

SymEFA.remediation: Component of SEP. Same remediation as symefa.

SRTSP.remediation: Exclude CSV paths in SEP policy.

eeCtrl.remediation: Component of SEP DLP. Verify cluster-aware configuration.

BHDrvx64.remediation: SEP heuristic component. Verify SEP version supports CSV.

ehdrv.remediation: Use ESET cluster-aware configuration. Exclude CSV paths.

epp64.remediation: Exclude CSV paths. Known CSV incompatibility in older versions.

klif.remediation: Known CSV incompatibility. Exclude CSV paths and verify Kaspersky version supports clusters.

TmXPFlt.remediation: Exclude CSV paths in OfficeScan / Apex One policy.

tmcomm.remediation: Component of OfficeScan / Apex One. Exclude CSV paths.

tmactmon.remediation: Component of OfficeScan. Exclude CSV paths.

SAVOnAccess.remediation: Must use cluster-aware configuration. Exclude CSV paths in Sophos Central policy.

sld.remediation: Component of Sophos Central. Verify cluster support.
